purpose: Continue the three-session offline research program after Campaign012 produced zero development survivors. This record considers only economic meaning and accepted source-schema feasibility, rejects terminal or near-synonym mechanisms before values, and selects at most one concept for a separate exact no-value overlap audit.

concepts_rejected_before_formula_or_valu.reason: Campaign012 is terminal. Changing its lag, correlation estimator, range transform, zero-pair semantics, direction, years, costs, or combining its values would be prohibited rescue.
Higher lags, partial autocorrelation, transition bins, runs, shock-conditioned persistence, and range-compression ratios are direct variants of Campaign012's terminal sequence-memory question.
Unordered dispersion and concentration reopen Campaign011; time-of-day allocation reopens terminal volatility-resolution and late-window mechanisms.

Overlap and containment reopen Campaign010. A path of interval midpoints would become another price-path or terminal-location mechanism rather than the selected within-bar transaction-reference question.
Candle bodies, wicks, signed close location, and close pressure reopen Campaign009, terminal-close location, or terminal same-bar VWAP-close pressure and require forbidden open or close fields.
Correlations or regressions between range magnitude and amount or volume reopen terminal amount-volatility coupling, directional price-impact asymmetry, and liquidity mechanisms.
Adjacent amount/volume price changes reopen Campaign006 and cumulative transaction-reference crossings reopen prospective Candidate49.
Peer residualization and synchronization reopen terminal market-relative mechanisms and add a benchmark-estimation degree of freedom unrelated to the selected single-stock within-bar question.

selected_concept.mechanism: Measure how the one-minute high-low exploration envelope is distributed above versus below that same bar's executed average transaction price. The concept uses the transaction-weighted price only as an internal center of each bar and deliberately ignores the open, close, adjacent-bar order, terminal location, and market peers.
selected_concept.economic_question: Does repeated upside-dominant price exploration around where shares actually traded reveal latent buying interest that persists from the next open through the third close, or does downside-dominant exploration identify unresolved supply?
known_design_risks: the exact within-bar center, aggregation, weighting, active-bar minimum, transaction-unit handling, high-low/VWAP ordering, zero-activity semantics, valid range, and direction create researcher degrees of freedom unless frozen before values
raw high-low ordering and active-bar transaction VWAP containment must be validated fail-closed rather than repaired
using close relative to transaction VWAP would duplicate the terminal bar-VWAP close-pressure mechanism
using adjacent transaction-price changes would duplicate Campaign006 and using cumulative VWAP crossings would duplicate Candidate49
weighting the envelope by amount or regressing it on activity would overlap terminal amount-volatility or liquidity mechanisms

the candidate may still be statistically redundant with terminal same-bar VWAP close pressure, body-range efficiency, adjacent-range overlap, range entropy, or range reversal even if its measurement is semantically distinct

decision.required_next_step: Perform a separate no-value audit against all 36 prior terminal mechanisms and prospective Candidate49. Only if the concept remains economically distinct may that audit freeze one exact formula, direction, transaction-unit and bar-containment semantics, zero-activity and minimum-support rules, no-return gates, and one finite trial before candidate or comparison values or returns are read.
